title: law (laws/W-NN.yaml)
description: One law of WEB_TOPS.md section 8.2, with the fields of section 8.3. The section 8.2 table is generated from these files.

family.description: The section 8.2 table the law is listed in: the bold name above it.

severity.description: R: a break is refuse. A: a break needs an acknowledgement, or is ack-missing.

classes.description: The launch classes that map the law (section 5.2).

conditional_classes.description: The classes in `classes` that map the law only when the project depends on Astro.

kinds.description: tl: a tool. an: a webtops rule or reader. at: attested by review. tbd: not yet implemented.

text.description: The Reader cell of the section 8.2 table, as written there.

rules.description: The tool rules, flags and checks the law maps, by tool.

classes.description: The classes in the law's `classes` this rule applies to. Absent: every class the law maps.

judged.description: v0.1: ticked in section 8.2. m3: gets a reader in milestone M3. no: not judged yet.
